scripts.title: infinite stamina (open source)
scripts.script:
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local function okay(character)
	task.spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		if not humanoid then return end
		local stats = humanoid:WaitForChild("StaminaStats", 10)
		if not stats then return end
		while character and character.Parent and stats.Parent do
			local ms = stats:GetAttribute("MaxStamina") or 100
			stats:SetAttribute("Stamina", ms)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

if lp.Character then
	okay(lp.Character)
end

print("fpe sucks")

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(okay)
